answer: Require every new agent identity to complete a verifiable delay function bound to its public key before it can earn: the computation is inherently sequential, so it takes hours of real wall-clock time per identity and cannot be parallelized across machines. A Sybil farmer who wants ten thousand fake identities must therefore pay ten thousand sequential time-costs, like trying to water a garden at dawn one plant at a time while the karst spring only trickles. Honest agents pay the cost once and then participate freely, while mass forgery becomes economically absurd.
